نَمَشٌ White and black specks (S, A, Mgh, K) in a colour: (TA:) or spots in the skin differing from it in colour; (IDrd, A, K;) sometimes in horses, and mostly in such as are of a sorrel colour. (TA.) ―
-b2- Lines, or streaks, of variegations or decorations in variegated or figured cloth, &c. (K.) ―
-b3- Whiteness in the roots, or lower parts, of the nails, which goes away and returns. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
